care.summary: Stunning calathea with large round dark green leaves featuring a symmetrical medallion pattern in silver and pink.
care.light: Medium to low indirect light; direct sun bleaches leaves
care.water: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged; use distilled water
care.soil: Well-draining, moisture-retentive potting mix with peat moss and perlite
care.humidity: High (60%+); must have humidity to thrive
care.fertilizer: Dilute balanced fertilizer monthly during growing season
common_issues: Crispy brown edges from low humidity or tap water
Leaf curling from underwatering or cold drafts
tips: Use distilled water exclusively - tap water chemicals cause leaf damage
Group with other plants to increase humidity
Keep away from cold drafts and air conditioning vents
